oracle.statement: POST cluster op on a never-created collection returns exactly 404; move_shard with non-existent to_peer_id on an existing collection returns exactly 400; create_sharding_key on a custom-sharded collection returns 200 - 2xx on missing/invalid faces is Type1_IllegalSuccess, other status classes are Type4 wrong-disposition, 5xx with /healthz alive is Type3 (assertion qdrant_behavioral_cluster_collection_update_001)
